description: This PHP source file defines the configuration class for the Core OAuth plugin in the OrangeHRM system. It sets up dependency injection for OAuth-related services and registers an OAuth subscriber within the event dispatcher.

classes.name: CoreOAuthPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Defines the configuration for the OAuth plugin, including service registration and event subscription setup.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin configuration by registering OAuth services and adding the OAuth subscriber to the event dispatcher.
